description: GymAI Agent MVP - Intelligent AI Agent for Gym Customer Communication & Retention

userStories.title: Add Health Score calculation
userStories.description: As a gym owner, I need the system to calculate a Health Score (1-100) for each customer based on their activity patterns so I can identify at-risk members.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a HealthScore model in src/gym_agent/models/ with frequency_score, trend_score, recency_score, and expiry_score fields
Implement calculate_health_score function with weights: frequency(30%), trend(25%), recency(25%), expiry(20%)
Score < 50: Critical, 50-70: At-risk, > 70: Healthy
Add health score calculation to MockCRM service
Typecheck passes (mypy)
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Already implemented in customer.py and mock_crm.py. Fixed type annotations.

userStories.title: Add conversation persistence with MongoDB
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store conversations and messages in a database so the agent can maintain context across sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create MongoDB connection and collections for conversations and messages
Add database initialization in src/gym_agent/services/database.py
Store conversation_id, customer_id, channel, status, timestamps
Store messages with direction, content, intent, sentiment
Typecheck passes
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented DatabaseService with motor async driver. 7 unit tests passing.

userStories.title: Implement conversation history tracking
userStories.description: As a customer, I want the agent to remember my previous messages in this conversation so I don't have to repeat myself.
acceptanceCriteria: Integrate database service with GymAgent class
Load last 10 messages when processing a new message
Pass conversation history to the LLM for context
Store each message and response in the database
Typecheck passes
Test conversation continuity in Telegram bot
userStories.notes: Integrated MongoDB with GymAgent. Messages automatically stored and loaded. Changed default LLM to Gemini 2.5 Flash.

userStories.title: Add proactive absence check-in trigger
userStories.description: As a gym owner, I want the system to automatically send a check-in message to members who haven't visited in 7+ days.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ProactiveOutreach service in src/gym_agent/services/outreach.py
Implement get_absent_customers() returning customers with 7+ days since last visit
Generate personalized check-in messages using the agent
Add CLI command to trigger absence check-in batch
Respect MAX_UNANSWERED_MESSAGES = 2 limit
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the core retention feature

userStories.description: As an agent, I need to accurately detect customer intents so I can provide appropriate responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Add example prompts for each Intent type to system prompt
Add detection for compound intents (e.g., question + time_constraint)

acceptanceCriteria: Implement per-customer message rate limiting
